summary: Fallback to the JavaScript object model when class prototype methods may be replaced, deleted, or redefined after class evaluation.

target.notes: Materialize and use the JavaScript prototype object for method lookup instead of compiling calls to fixed C# methods.

caveats: Do not mark a method native merely because its original class declaration is statically known.

tests.name: method replacement observed
tests.input: class C { m(){return 1;} } C.prototype.m=()=>2; console.log(new C().m());

tests.name: edge: deletion exposes ancestor method
tests.input: class B { m(){return 1;} } class D extends B { m(){return 2;} } delete D.prototype.m; console.log(new D().m());
